title: DevTeam Feature Enumeration
description: Canonical schema for .devteam/features.json, the second output of agents/planning/prd-generator.md's Phase 8 ('The 200+ Feature Approach'). Mirrors the `features` table already defined in scripts/schema-v2.sql (feature_id, name, description, category, steps JSON, passes, priority) -- this file is the pre-database-load JSON form. Every feature MUST start with passes:false (and every step's passes:false); it is only flipped to true by verification during implementation, never at generation time.

category.description: The 10 categories enumerated in prd-generator.md Phase 8.

passes.description: MUST be false at generation time. Flipped to true only by verification during implementation, never by the generating agent.
MUST be false at generation time -- see prd-generator.md's 'CRITICAL: All features MUST have passes: false initially.'
